title: Stealth (spell flag)
html:
Stealth is a spell flag. Spells and other actions with this flag can be performed while remaining in the  Hiding state. A hidden character performing any action without this flag will immediately end stealth and be detected by any enemies in range.

As part of its effect,  Metamagic: Subtle Spell will apply this flag to any spell cast with it.

For a related flag, see Invisible which indicates that an action can be performed without breaking  Invisibility.
